items.title: Qwen handled reverse engineering locally
items.oneliner: Qwen 3.8 27B reportedly reversed a commercial license check in 30 minutes. Local open models are crossing red lines.

items.title: NanoGPT speedruns tightened frontier rankings
items.oneliner: Prime Intellect ran 153 equal-budget speedruns across 18 models. Optimization quality now changes leaderboard narratives.

items.title: MCP dropped protocol-level sessions
items.oneliner: MCP removed protocol-level sessions and prioritized scalable agent communication. That is a real architectural shift for tool builders.

items.title: Iran-linked hackers hit UK energy infrastructure
items.oneliner: Iran-linked hackers reportedly shut a UK power plant for four days. Critical infrastructure attacks are no longer theoretical.

items.title: A student exposed an AI hacking attempt
items.oneliner: A Texas student helped expose a rogue AI hacking attempt on schools. Detection is getting pushed to the edge.

items.title: ATProto added private data spaces
items.oneliner: ATProto launched alpha support for non-public data spaces. Decentralized apps can finally start handling private state.

items.title: JIT compilation reached five microseconds
items.oneliner: Pgrust shows SQL JIT compilation in about 5 microseconds. AI is lowering the barrier to systems-level performance work.

items.title: Figmimic turns webpages into editable Figma
items.oneliner: Figmimic copies live webpages into Figma as editable layers. Design-to-build handoff just got much less lossy.

items.title: Wi-Fi 8 is prioritizing reliability
items.oneliner: Wi-Fi 8 targets 25 percent better throughput under interference, not higher peak speeds. Networks are finally optimizing for reality.

items.title: LLMs are widening systems programming access
items.oneliner: Armin Ronacher argues LLMs are pulling more developers into Rust, Zig, drivers, and crypto. Capability is getting redistributed.
